_readme: First own-site map read at College of the Canyons (S345, SkyLantern). Its mapper (canyons.programmapper.ws) answered 403 on 2026-10-04 (run 37198225537), so the registry records it refused, and Sam's ruling (sheet 29 card 3) sends the reader to look for the sequence on the college's own pages. A web search (2026-10-08) found department program pages that say 'Check out the Program Mapper and the recommended course sequence documents below' (Business; Administration of Justice has the same page shape). This read loads two of them and follows the sequence documents they link.

questions.map_source: Whether the college's own department pages publish a recommended course sequence per program, and in what form.
questions.map_shape: How one sequence document names its terms and lists its courses.
